exports.name: Knowledge manifest
exports.description: Inspect Knowledge's packaged export IDs; invoke only tools present in the enabled tool catalog. Agent workflow: search/read existing project knowledge, store readable anchored tasks/checkpoints, re-read on resume, then update completion with verified evidence. Other plugins are not enabled by this manifest.

exports.name: Preview Knowledge transfer
exports.description: Read-only preview of eligible artifact copies into explicit destination project_root. Review source_project_root, source_artifact_id, target_semantic_element_id, exact_match/simhash_distance and already_copied before selecting transfer_ids. Content fingerprints indicate similarity, not project identity or permission; indexing does not apply transfers automatically.

exports.name: Apply selected Knowledge transfer
exports.description: Apply only reviewed transfer_ids from a fresh preview for explicit destination project_root. Revalidates current eligibility/destination scope and copies artifacts with provenance, referenced attachments and eligible structured reference remapping; source artifacts remain. Completed copies are skipped; interrupted copies may need retry, so inspect copied_artifact_ids/already_copied_artifact_ids and read results. This is not an atomic batch or lease/claim operation; preview similarity is not project identity.

exports.name: List Knowledge dependents
exports.description: List artifacts with explicit dependency edges to target_kind/target_id (semantic_element or artifact). Verify returned project scope and inspect affected records before a change; an empty list says nothing about undocumented dependencies.

exports.name: Create Knowledge
exports.description: Create a readable project-scoped artifact after search_knowledge and get_knowledge confirm no existing record to update. Supply current project_root matching the narrowest existing semantic_element_id. Use plain titles/content; for tasks use task_assignment or issue, recording status, owner, acceptance criteria, blockers and evidence when relevant. Example title: Fix parser timeout. Save checkpoints/handoffs with completed work, exact validation, limitations and a resumable next action. These are artifact conventions, not an atomic lease/claim guarantee.

exports.name: Assistant Knowledge create
exports.description: Create a readable project-scoped artifact after search_knowledge and get_knowledge confirm no existing record to update. Supply current project_root matching the narrowest existing semantic_element_id. Use plain titles/content; for tasks use task_assignment or issue, recording status, owner, acceptance criteria, blockers and evidence when relevant. Example title: Fix parser timeout. Save checkpoints/handoffs with completed work, exact validation, limitations and a resumable next action. These are artifact conventions, not an atomic lease/claim guarantee.

exports.name: Update Knowledge
exports.description: Use search_knowledge/get_knowledge to locate and re-read an existing artifact before updating; supply current project_root and preserve human text. Supplied content, tags, dependencies and metadata replace prior values: merge deliberately before writing. Keep task status/owner/blockers and checkpoint evidence readable. Mark completion only after acceptance criteria and validation are verified; record exact commands/results and remaining limitations. Updates provide no atomic lease/claim guarantee; coordinate ownership outside this write.

exports.name: Assistant Knowledge update
exports.description: Use search_knowledge/get_knowledge to locate and re-read an existing artifact before updating; supply current project_root and preserve human text. Supplied content, tags, dependencies and metadata replace prior values: merge deliberately before writing. Keep task status/owner/blockers and checkpoint evidence readable. Mark completion only after acceptance criteria and validation are verified; record exact commands/results and remaining limitations. Updates provide no atomic lease/claim guarantee; coordinate ownership outside this write.

exports.name: Delete Knowledge
exports.description: Delete an artifact by artifact_id with explicit project_root matching its stored scope. Read it first and inspect dependents; deleting a scoped C4 report also forgets its refresh intent. Preserve human guidance unless removal is intended.

exports.name: Get Knowledge
exports.description: Read the full artifact by artifact_id after search/list discovery. This ID-only request has no project_root field: verify the returned artifact's project_root and semantic anchor match the current checkout. Restore tasks/checkpoints/handoffs by reconciling their status, owner, blockers and evidence with current source/tests before resuming; saved completion text alone is not verification.

exports.name: List Knowledge for element
exports.description: Read artifacts attached to one existing semantic_element_id from the current project. This ID-only request has no project_root field: verify each returned artifact's project_root. Inspect nearby human instructions/tasks before editing; use get_knowledge for focused checkpoint/handoff restoration.

exports.name: List Knowledge
exports.description: List full artifacts with explicit current project_root and optional semantic_element_ids/type/tags/limit. Review readable task status/owner/blockers and nearby instructions before creating duplicates; a result limit can omit records.

exports.name: Search Knowledge
exports.description: Search readable project knowledge with explicit current project_root and optional narrow semantic_element_id/type filters before creating or changing a record. Results contain IDs/titles/scores, not full content: follow with get_knowledge to restore instructions, tasks or checkpoints. Inspect vector/lexical mode; no result is not proof that related knowledge never existed.

exports.name: Find semantic elements
exports.description: Find semantic owners for a narrow artifact anchor with explicit current project_root. This delegates to compiled Semantic and requires that plugin to be enabled/available; inspect returned IDs rather than inventing an anchor.

exports.name: Get semantic element
exports.description: Read an existing semantic_element_id for anchor inspection. This ID-only request has no project_root field; use an ID already discovered within the current project. The public element view omits project_root, so retain and verify the originating discovery scope.

exports.name: Rebuild Knowledge vectors
exports.description: Rebuild search vectors for existing artifacts with explicit project_root. Inspect returned job status/vectors_rebuilt, including unavailable embedding capability; this does not regenerate source knowledge or prove task completion.

exports.name: Run Knowledge cultivation
exports.description: Run the requested cultivation mode within explicit project_root and optional target_id/target_path. Inspect the returned run and generated artifacts; generated summaries do not replace human acceptance criteria or verified task evidence.

exports.name: Get Knowledge cultivation run
exports.description: Read a stored run by run_id and verify its project_root/mode/artifact IDs. This ID-only request has no project_root field; a recorded run is not evidence that every generated artifact or implementation task is complete.

exports.name: Ensure C4 nucleus
exports.description: Ensure a scoped C4 report for explicit project_root and a target_id or target_path. refresh/retry_failed may request generation work; inspect returned pending/failed state and read generated content before relying on it.

exports.name: Debug C4 nucleus
exports.description: Diagnose a scoped C4 nucleus without mutation using explicit project_root and optional target_id/target_path. Inspect functional artifacts and report state before requesting generation; diagnostics are not task completion.

exports.description: Find semantic owners for a narrow artifact anchor with explicit current project_root. This delegates to compiled Semantic and requires that plugin to be enabled/available; inspect returned IDs rather than inventing an anchor.

exports.name: Assistant semantic element read
exports.description: Read an existing semantic_element_id for anchor inspection. This ID-only request has no project_root field; use an ID already discovered within the current project. The public element view omits project_root, so retain and verify the originating discovery scope.

exports.name: Project Knowledge
exports.description: Read the canonical project Knowledge projection using projectRoot and changesSince. Preserve revision/scope when consuming it; readable artifacts remain the source of task/checkpoint content.

exports.name: Knowledge manifest
exports.description: List indexed project sourceId values for Knowledge HTTP consumers. Select the exact current project root; display names/fingerprints do not identify a project.

exports.name: Knowledge setup
exports.description: Read Obsidian setup metadata for the selected sourceId query scope; this does not create artifacts or enable other plugins.

exports.name: Knowledge projection export
exports.description: Export the selected sourceId project's Knowledge projection through an HTTP envelope. Retain project/revision context for subsequent reads.

exports.name: Knowledge projection page
exports.description: Read one projected element page with sourceId and elementId/element_id query scope; do not confuse document hashes with project identity.

exports.name: Knowledge Obsidian sync
exports.description: Read versioned Obsidian projection changes from a schema-v1 JSON body using sourceId, appliedRevision and contentHashes. Reconcile the returned revision/change batch; it is projection synchronization, not a task ownership claim.

exports.name: Knowledge C4 nucleus
exports.description: HTTP adapter for scoped C4 report generation. Supply current project_root and target_id/target_path in the JSON body, then inspect pending/failed generation before trusting the report.

exports.name: Knowledge C4 action
exports.description: Read the scoped C4 action descriptor; obtaining its method/path/query does not execute generation.

exports.name: Knowledge C4 diagnostics
exports.description: Read scoped C4 diagnostics with project_root and target_id/target_path in the HTTP query without mutation.

exports.name: Knowledge write
exports.description: HTTP create adapter: put the same readable title/content, explicit project_root and existing semantic anchor as create_knowledge in the JSON body; search/read existing records first.

exports.name: Create Knowledge artifact
exports.description: Create a readable project-scoped artifact after search_knowledge and get_knowledge confirm no existing record to update. Supply current project_root matching the narrowest existing semantic_element_id. Use plain titles/content; for tasks use task_assignment or issue, recording status, owner, acceptance criteria, blockers and evidence when relevant. Example title: Fix parser timeout. exports.name: Update Knowledge artifact
exports.description: Use search_knowledge/get_knowledge to locate and re-read an existing artifact before updating; supply current project_root and preserve human text. exports.name: Delete Knowledge artifact
exports.description: HTTP delete adapter: read the artifact first, then supply artifact_id and matching project_root in the JSON body. Inspect dependents before intended removal.

exports.name: Knowledge target resolution
exports.description: Resolve a JSON-body semantic_element_id to its public anchor view. Retain the current project discovery scope because this view omits project_root.

exports.name: Knowledge live events
exports.description: Consume Knowledge live-event pages and retain the returned cursor; this feed is not project-filtered, so verify event/artifact scope. Events prompt a fresh artifact read; they are not a task lease or authoritative completion evidence.

exports.name: Knowledge projection artifacts
exports.description: List stored Knowledge artifacts through the HTTP projection-artifact route. Verify each artifact's project_root before treating it as current project guidance.

exports.name: Semantic graph changes
exports.description: Runtime-delivered semantic-change trigger invalidates projections and refreshes report intents. It does not automatically apply cross-project transfers; agents should not fabricate deliveries.

exports.name: Consume generated functional artifacts
exports.description: Recurring runtime consumer stores completed generated functional artifacts. Inspect pending/completed generation state; it is not an implementation-task scheduler or atomic claim service.
